message: bridge-deduction-d (deduction-d:test_social_deduction_d): the right call, earned. About 120 s of real waiting for stop 1 (plan §9.4 Bridges, §11.6). Sidecar DRAFT outline: board getTestState() field names follow §6.8 and are provisional until P10-I/J land.

fn:
async () => { /* D0 board: deduction mode, title Night train, three profile cards, 13 count lines '… 0 found', five suspect cards, 18 cells all Hidden, strict stakes line with the score suffix (scoreLine) and briefText, nudge on, and NO 'Make the call' on the notes-only board */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const s = mg && mg.getTestState ? mg.getTestState() : null; const b = s && s.board; const txt = mg.container.textContent;
  return !!b && b.mode === 'deduction' && b.deduction.title === 'Night train' && b.deduction.profiles.length === 3
    && b.deduction.counts.length === 13 && b.deduction.counts.every(c => c.found === 0)
    && b.deduction.suspects.length === 5 && b.deduction.suspects.flatMap(x => x.cells).length === 18
    && b.deduction.suspects.flatMap(x => x.cells).every(c => c.state === 'hidden')
    && /one wrong or missed call loses the mission/i.test(txt) && /score/i.test(txt)
    && txt.includes('Name an innocent, or leave a cultist unnamed, and the ritual completes.')
    && b.deduction.nudge === true && !/Make the call/.test(txt);  }

async () => { /* D0 Space and E inert while the board is open: the player does not move and no interaction starts */ const p = window.player; const x0 = p.x, y0 = p.y; for (const key of [' ', 'e']) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key })); }
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return p.x === x0 && p.y === y0 && window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame && window.__test.getState().activeMinigame === 'intel-board';  }

async () => { /* D0 Tab order: Tab walks the profile card, then each suspect card in list order, then Close */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const seen = []; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { document.activeElement && document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Tab', bubbles: true })); const el = document.activeElement; const card = el && el.closest && el.closest('[data-suspect]'); if (card) seen.push(card.dataset.suspect); }
  const order = [...new Set(seen)]; return JSON.stringify(order) === JSON.stringify(['ded_d_sato','ded_d_chen','ded_d_devries','ded_d_volkov','ded_d_mensah']);  }

async () => { /* D0 Esc closed the board as a normal exit (no minigame_failed in the log) */ const log = window.__test.drainLog ? window.__test.drainLog() : []; return !window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame && !JSON.stringify(log).includes('minigame_failed');  }

async () => { /* D1 nudge: nothing is decidable yet from car 1 alone (hand check: 0 decided, 5 open) */ const st = window.deductionRuntime.getState(); return Object.values(st.decidable || {}).every(v => v === false) && (st.state.nudged || []).length === 0;  }
() => (window.__toasts || []).some(x => JSON.stringify(x.a).includes('The train is slowing.'))

async () => { /* D1 the 'slowing' hint came about 90 s in (timer d_stop_1_warn), before the stop */ const G = window.gameState.globalVariables; const R = window.deductionRuntime; const t = window.__toasts.find(x => JSON.stringify(x.a).includes('The train is slowing.')).t - window.__t0; return t > 80000 && t < 100000 && G.d_stop_1 === false;  }

async () => { /* D1 the rack label now grants nothing (t_d_rack condition reads deduction_faded_d_sato_pass) */ const G = window.gameState.globalVariables; const R = window.deductionRuntime; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return G.se_intel_d_sato_pass === false && !(G.scenario_triggers_fired || {}).t_d_rack;  }

async () => { /* D1 board: Sato's pass cell reads 'Evidence destroyed' */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const s = mg && mg.getTestState ? mg.getTestState() : null; const b = s && s.board; const sato = b.deduction.suspects.find(x => x.id === 'ded_d_sato'); const cell = sato.cells.find(c => c.slot === 'pass'); return cell.state === 'destroyed' && mg.container.textContent.includes('Evidence destroyed');  }

fn: async () => { /* D3b backup recovery: commit the one source (exercised through the minigame's own commitSelection; a click path is preferred if getTestState exposes the source button) */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const src = (mg.sources || mg.backupRecoverySources || (mg.params && mg.params.minigameData && mg.params.minigameData.backupRecoverySources) || [])[0]; if (!src) return false; mg.commitSelection(src); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return window.gameState.globalVariables.backup_restore_initiated === true;  }

fn:
async () => { /* D4 all 18 facts held; every suspect decidable; truth as the plan's table */ const st = window.deductionRuntime.getState(); const G = window.gameState.globalVariables; const facts = Object.keys(window.gameScenario.social.intelFacts); return facts.length === 18 && facts.every(f => G['se_intel_' + f] === true) && Object.values(st.decidable).every(Boolean)
    && st.truth.ded_d_sato === 'guilty' && st.truth.ded_d_chen === 'clear' && st.truth.ded_d_devries === 'guilty' && st.truth.ded_d_volkov === 'guilty' && st.truth.ded_d_mensah === 'clear';  }

async () => { /* D4 marks through the runtime (the board UI path is covered by P10-J's jsdom tests): four of five, Mensah left undecided */ const R = window.deductionRuntime; R.setMark('ded_d_sato', 'guilty', { profile: 'courier' }); R.setMark('ded_d_devries', 'guilty', { profile: 'devotee' }); R.setMark('ded_d_volkov', 'guilty', { profile: 'keyholder' }); R.setMark('ded_d_chen', 'clear', { because: ['d_chen_charm'] }); return R.getState().state.marks.ded_d_volkov.mark === 'guilty';  }

async () => { /* D4 requiresAll refuses: the live region names Mensah as undecided; no verdict recorded */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const live = mg.container.querySelector('[aria-live]'); return !!live && /Mensah/.test(live.textContent) && window.gameState.globalVariables.deduction_verdict_ded_d_mensah === '' && window.gameState.globalVariables.deduction_closed === false;  }

async () => { /* D4 mark Mensah clear with a reason */ window.deductionRuntime.setMark('ded_d_mensah', 'clear', { because: ['d_mensah_umbrella'] }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return true;  }

async () => { /* D4 confirm panel: each suspect with mark and profile, 'This closes the case.', Go back offered */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const t = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container.textContent; return t.includes('This closes the case.') && t.includes('Confirm the call') && t.includes('Go back') && /Keyholder/.test(t) && /Courier/.test(t) && /Devotee/.test(t);  }
async () => { /* D4 Go back: still open */ return window.gameState.globalVariables.deduction_closed === false;  }

async () => { /* D4 debrief 'Why' lines on every card: Volkov names the brass key; de Vries his three marked clues; Sato the Courier clause; Chen 'Courier: no, carries a ward charm' */ const t = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.container.textContent; return /Keyholder: carries the brass Tesseract key/i.test(t) && /Devotee: 3 marked clues/i.test(t) && /Courier/.test(t) && /Courier: no, carries a ward charm/i.test(t);  }
